about_html:
From a speck of dust to a black hole

You begin as a tiny speck of dust drifting through space. Gather matter with gravity and combine evolution paths and skills to grow into a greater celestial body. What once drew in tiny resources will one day shatter and devour entire planets.

The form you take and the powers that drive your growth are yours to choose.

Turn your resources into your next step forward

Draw in nearby resources with gravity and gather the materials you need to grow. Decide whether to strengthen your abilities now or save resources for your next evolution.

Prepare steadily in safer regions, or venture into new areas in search of more resources.

How much are you willing to risk to grow?

Shatter larger planets. Devour them.

Collide with another celestial body to enter a spinning battle. Amid clashing worlds and showers of sparks, defeat your opponent and absorb the matter left behind to accelerate your growth.

The stronger your opponent, the more preparation matters. Decide whether to fight now or refine your build and return.

Combine evolutions and skills. Find your own way to grow.

Meet the requirements for your next evolution, then choose a new form and new abilities. Unlock skills through exploration and challenges, and change your loadout to add the abilities you need.

Focus on gathering to prepare for growth, or invest in offense to take on stronger opponents. Bolster your survival and wait for an opening, or mix different abilities for a balanced approach.

Even from the same starting point, your choices can lead to very different builds.

Observe to find your way. Use gravity to change course.

Use gravity pulses in Observation Mode to study nearby celestial bodies and choose your next destination. Prepare in resource-rich regions, recover a core from a high-temperature zone, or set out in search of a powerful opponent.

Change course with swing-by maneuvers and explore a universe crossed by meteor showers. Choosing where to go and when to take on a challenge is part of growing, too.

Survive an unpredictable universe

Even a peaceful expedition can change at any moment. Adapt your plans to meteor showers sweeping across your route and encounters you never saw coming.

Decide whether to retreat from danger or seize an opportunity and take on the challenge. The choice you make now could lay the groundwork for your next stage of growth.

Gather resources, perfect your own build, and challenge something greater.

Momoawase | A Memory Game Full of "Mo"

A memory game with strange rules my 3-year-old daughter decided on all by herself.

Turn over a card and it says "も" (mo). Turn over another — "も" again. Two ordinary "も" cards make a pair. So far, it's the memory game you know.

The twist: some cards are a different color. These are animal cards — each one shows a single letter of an animal's name in Japanese, and five of them spell out the whole name. For example, 「あ」「ら」「い」「ぐ」「ま」 spells "araiguma," the Japanese word for raccoon.

Raccoon, long-tailed tit... Flip an animal's cards in the order of its name to collect it. The name is shown at the top left of the screen, so you don't need to read Japanese. Flip one out of order, and the cards turn face down again.

Grab an ordinary "も", or hunt for the next card in an animal's name?

🍑 Three Modes

  • Survival: You start with 5 lives, and every miss costs one. Clear all the cards and move on to the next round.

  • Time Attack: Race the clock to clear all 52 cards. The board shuffles every now and then, so stay sharp.

  • Score Attack: Rack up as many points as you can in 60 seconds. Animal combos are the key to a high score.

Each round takes just a few minutes, so it's perfect for a short break. Your best time, high score, and top rank are saved for each mode, so you can jump right back in whenever you want to beat your record.

🖍️ Doodles Fill Up Your Desk

Every time you clear a mission, a new doodle appears on the desk. These doodles were drawn by my own child and appear in the game just as they are. Collect them all, and your desk gets pretty lively.

🎮 Controls

Play with a mouse, keyboard, or gamepad.

Streaming & Let's Plays

Streams and Let's Play videos are welcome from both individuals and companies, and you're free to monetize them. When streaming or posting videos, please follow these guidelines:

  • Include the game's title in your video or stream title. (Required)

  • Include a link to the Steam store page in your video description. (Optional)

“If only I had bought Bitcoin back then...”

“I knew NVIDIA was going somewhere. Why didn’t I invest?”

Everyone has thought about it at least once.

But what if you could actually go back?

It is the year 2030. After losing your job to AI, you struggle to get through each day with little hope for the future.

Then a home AI robot named Honey Dragon (H.D.) appears and offers you a second chance:

Return to 2010—and seize the investment opportunity of a lifetime.

Trade and Live Through History

Money Makes Money: Historical Market Simulator takes you through the markets of 2010–2025.

Search for companies, study charts, read historical news, and trade stocks and cryptocurrencies before advancing to the next month.

Invest in companies before they reshape the world. Enter the cryptocurrency market before it becomes mainstream. Prepare for the crashes, recoveries, and opportunities that history has already revealed.

You already know what happens next.

Not sure where to start? Don’t worry—H.D. will be there to guide you.

Build, Protect, and Spend Your Fortune

Knowing the future does not make every decision easy.

Living costs continue to accumulate, and unexpected events demand money.

If you succeed greatly in your investments and living expenses are no longer a problem,

You can also spend your fortune on minigames, including an anime-style gacha game and an idle RPG, or you can also create your own figure collection.

You were given a second chance to build a fortune.

This game is not just about investing.



As time passes, strange things sometimes happen

You might receive an unexpected letter, fall victim to a hack, or even stumble upon a bizarre, unknown place.

As you experience and navigate these events, a question inevitably arises:

Why did the protagonist travel back to the past?

And if you become wealthy, will you truly be able to find happiness again?

Collect, train, and battle! A roguelite deck-building auto battler!

Make the most of each Monmusu's personality, and combine skills and items to build the strongest team!

New Mode [Auto Battle Rush]

Auto Battle Rush is an asynchronous PvP mode where you battle other players' teams.

No progression upgrades apply. Even right after starting the game, you can compete under fair rules!

Choose from randomly appearing allies and items, and aim for a powerful lineup!

A team that reaches 10 wins becomes your "Representative Team" and awaits other players!

[Story Mode]

Story Mode is a single-player mode where you explore the map and battle NPCs.

A battle tournament is being held on the island where the Monmusu live.

Become the leader of the Monmusu and aim for victory together with your allies.

Gather allies and triumph over your rivals!

Game Flow 1 [Leader Select]

Choose one of five leaders to fight as. The other four appear as your rivals.

Game Flow 2 [Field Map]

Explore the field, gathering allies and items to prepare for battle.

Game Flow 3 [Battle]

When the time comes, a battle against a rival begins. Win to advance to the next stage.

Game Flow 4 [Run Rewards]

Earn Prism Gummies based on your battle results.

Spend them on Shop purchases or on character Training for permanent power-ups.

Strategy Tip 1 [Check Ally & Enemy Info]

Be sure to check both ally and enemy info! You can see which skills will activate and any power-up effects from statuses.

Strategy Tip 2 [Placement & Fusion]

Generally, units in the front row act sooner, but they risk taking enemy attacks.

Choose your placements carefully.

You can also stack a card from your hand onto a character to fuse them for a power-up.

Strategy Tip 3 [Item Cards]

Spend the Gold you've gathered to buy Item Cards.

Use them on allies to teach skills and more — or use them on enemies for a chance to recruit them.

Strategy Tip 4 [Play to Their Strengths]

Each Monmusu has her own style of fighting, so plan your battle placements and Training to bring out their strengths as you take on the game!

The lane runs along the bottom of the screen, just below your ranch wall. The ranch fills everything above it. Up on the ranch you build a production line — spawn pens, belts, berry feeders, Element Baths, trainers and groupers — that breeds and buffs monsters. Down on the lane, those monsters hold the wall against the shadow waves pouring out of the rift.

Everything you build on the ranch is something that marches down there and fights. Throughput is power.

  • 65 breedable species across ten tiers, grown from four starters through a 61-recipe breeding tree.
  • Four elements — Ember, Frost, Terra and Volt. The bath a monster walks through is the monster you get.
  • Element Baths, feeders, trainers, groupers and belts that buff whatever rides past them. The route is the build.
  • Deaths are permanent. Anything that falls in the lane is gone, and the line has to make up the difference.

Between rounds you get the next wave's composition in advance, and time to rebuild against it. Then you hit START and find out whether you were right.

  • Wave previews so every retool is a real decision, not a guess.
  • A prize every round — 54 perks, drafted three at a time, rerollable.
  • 36 research nodes across four branches — Production, War, Economy and Ranching — banked in essence.
  • The Forge. Bosses drop rare parts and villains drop more; spend them on mods and marvels that buff everything passing by.
  • Rift debris and sabotage fouling your board — clear it with your critters, or build around it.

The campaign is three fifteen-round hunts, each ending with the warlord behind it stepping through the rift in person: Vexar, King of the Rift; Glorp, Sovereign of Slime; and Mother Mycel, who owns the last round of all. Between them come the Umbral Titan on the fifth-round bell, the Gravetide Empress on her tide of the drowned dark, Vexar's Nightmare Shepherd, and Gloop Prime — the heir that splits.

  • A 45-round campaign, then 100 rounds of Endless if the line still holds.
  • Three difficulty modes — Cozy Rancher, Rancher and Nightmare Shift.
  • Penny's Goal Board — 18 run goals, each paying essence.
  • 30 achievements and a full bestiary that fills in as you meet what's in the dark.

Gold survives defeat. Every run you bank it and come back to a stronger farmstead: 21 permanent upgrades across four tiers — more starting essence, thicker walls, wider gates, extra lane doors, a better-stocked wagon at Rikka's, and a Breeder Bot that works your pens while you fight. Your collection carries over too. Your best breeding pair of every species comes home.

Every species, machine, boss and shadow is hand-authored pixel art at a crisp 640x360, built in Godot 4. The original soundtrack runs twelve tracks with an in-game jukebox.

Monster Emblem: Vision Impossible is a classic 2D pixel-art Monster Collector RPG inspired by early-2000s console adventures.

After centuries of war, the factions of the realm have finally agreed to stop killing one another. Disputes will now be settled peacefully, sensibly, and responsibly through heavily armed monster duels.

As a foreign traveler, you are invited to explore this newly peaceful realm. Catch, train, and breed over 200 monsters, assemble your ideal team, and master a tactical grid-based combat system where movement and positioning can be just as important as raw power.

Challenge the leaders of every faction, collect their Faction Emblems, and earn your place in the Great Monster Tournament. Survive long enough, and you might even claim the legendary Monster Emblem. Easy enough. Probably.

  • Complete Your Bestiary: Discover over 200 unique monsters scattered across the realm. Some are adorable, some are horrifying, and some manage to be both.

  • Social Play: Join Steam Lobbies and see other players exploring the world in real time. Chat, trade monsters, challenge rival tamers to duels, or silently judge their team choices.

  • Tactical Grid Combat: Battles happen directly on the world map, transforming the surrounding terrain into a strategic battlefield. Position your monsters, plan their movement, and try to hit the tile you actually intended.

  • Quests: Help townsfolk and factions deal with stolen heirlooms, invading goblins, suspicious rituals, dangerously enthusiastic wildlife, and other perfectly normal local problems.

  • Bounty Hunts: Accept contracts to track down dangerous rogue monsters. Defeat or capture your target to earn rewards, improve your Bounty Hunter Rank, and gain access to even bigger things that want to eat you.

  • Breed Your Perfect Team: Pair compatible monsters to inherit useful skills and a portion of their parents' stats. Choose carefully, put them together, and politely give them some privacy.

For centuries, powerful factions fought for control of the realm, using monsters as their greatest weapons. The new peace agreement forbids humans from killing one another, grants free passage across the land, and replaces open warfare with regulated monster duels.

To keep humanity's competitive urges under control, the Seers Guild created the Great Monster Tournament. Any foreigner may compete, but only those who collect every Faction Emblem will be allowed into the Great Monster Arena. Your journey will take you through lands ruled by jesters, witches, wizards, druids, necromancers, Warlocks, and other people who should probably not be trusted with political authority.

Meanwhile, the supposedly all-seeing Seers are troubled by something they cannot perceive. Warlocks move beyond their psychic vision, helping some communities while alarming those in power. Whether they are dangerous villains or merely asking inconvenient questions is something you will have to decide for yourself.

Build your team. Explore the factions. Survive the jokes. Question absolutely everyone. Then enter the Great Monster Tournament and prove that an inexperienced foreigner with several dangerous creatures can solve problems that centuries of diplomacy could not.

Developer Note: A very long time ago I had a vision of the most fun game ever. Sadly enough I did not write any of it down and forgot most of it over time, but this one is also pretty fun.

I always wanted an open-world survival craft game full of monster girls. Nobody had made one. So I did. That's this game.

Picture this. You wake up in your base at dawn and outside the window, the slime girl you caught last night is watering the crops. So what will today be? Dig deeper toward that ore vein? Push into the ruined downtown? Or raise the walls before the seventh night comes? Out here every day is yours to decide.

  • Monster girls brought to life in gorgeous animation
  • Voxel building on fully destructible terrain
  • Capture and befriend them - they work, live and fight with you
  • A horde raid every seven days, with rewards for holding the line
  • Hack-and-slash loot with randomized options
  • Play it your way - slow life or adventure

A modern city swallowed by another world

You know this scenery. Paved roads, rows of buildings, an abandoned convenience store. But mana crystals split the asphalt and something inhuman flickers past the broken windows. In 2040 the city fell to another world. Human civilization left its resources; the otherworld brought its magic. You survive on the seam between the two.

Dig, build, claim your kingdom

Start with a shack that keeps the rain off. It becomes a wall, then a tower, then a castle. Every block of terrain can be broken and placed anywhere. An underground fortress, a hideout carved into a mountain, a keep towering over the plains - build the blueprint in your head. Farm in peace or gear up and raid the ruins. Slow life or adventure, your call.

Live with monster girls

The locals here are monster girls. In the wild they are dangerous. Wear them down, capture them, and they join you - companions on the road, hands around the base, fighters at your side when night falls. Every one of them moves in beautiful animation. Sometimes you will stop working just to watch them. Honestly, that might be the real game.

A horde every seven days

On the seventh night the horde comes. Are the walls high enough? Traps set? Girls in position? Hold until morning and the rewards are yours. Broken walls can be rebuilt. Next week you will do it better.

Hack and slash your arsenal

Weapons and gear roll random options. No two drops are the same. Today's find beats yesterday's - tomorrow's might beat them both. Dig, hunt, open chests, and chase the perfect roll.

If you love block-mining games, this will hit. Except this one is very sexy.
If you love monster-collecting games, this will hit too. Except the sexy points a different way.

Game Description:
MonsterGirl 3:Wukong is an interactive narrative game that blends strategic bargaining and branching storytelling. Collect and trade mystical elixirs as you, a seeker of divine artifacts, face trials set by enchanting yet cunning demon sisters. Every choice you make—driven by wisdom or desire—shapes the fate of these spirits. Unlock their stories, determine their destinies, and even invite them to your desktop as lively virtual companions!

Gameplay Features:

  • Strategic Elixir System: Acquire and utilize rare pills to gain an edge in high-stakes negotiations.

  • Five Unique Antagonists: Outsmart formidable foes—including the cunning Fox Spirit, the vengeful White Bone Demon, and the elusive Fourth Sister—each with their own motives and tactics.

  • Rich Narrative: Experience a deep, choice-driven story with multiple endings and branching paths.

  • Exclusive CGs & Illustrations: Unlock stunning artwork as you progress.

  • Desktop Pet System: Bring conquered spirits to life on your screen with interactive animations.

  • Item-Based Combat: Use collected elixirs to turn the tide in critical encounters.

Story Overview:

As a disciple on the path to enlightenment, you must navigate the schemes of five powerful "Demon Enchantresses"—each testing you in their own way. Will you resist temptation, exploit their weaknesses, or forge unexpected bonds? Your decisions will determine whether they become allies, adversaries, or something more...

(Note: Adjusted phrasing for broader appeal while retaining mystique. Replaced potentially sensitive terms like "conquer" with "unlock" and "determine their fates.")

Would you like any refinements for specific platforms (e.g., Steam’s guidelines)?

YOU ARE THE MONSTER

The kingdom's heroes have farmed slimes for generations — for loot, for experience, for sport. You are what crawled out of the pit afterward.

Mool: Chroma is a fast top-down roguelite about a very small slime and the very large things it has to kill.

COLOR IS YOUR BUILD

Five atoms — red, yellow, blue, white, shadow. Absorb them and they MIX. Red and yellow burn. Blue and shadow bite. Stack one color deep enough and it awakens into something else entirely.

Every run you are assembling a weapon out of light and pigment, and no two assemblies play the same. Explosive shells, chain lightning, piercing beams, homing curse missiles, a singularity that pulls a room into a point.

Nine apex forms sit at the end of the tree. Getting to one is the run.

THE HEROES ARE THE HORROR

Five champions wait at the bottom of the kingdom, and none of them are still people.

A glutton who never stopped eating. A hunter who cannot stop drawing. A mage who unraveled. A captain whose armor kept fighting after he left it.

And beneath them all, the king who ate slimes until he became one — a wall of black ichor with a drowned crown and a hundred swallowed eyes, still watching.

THE ALTAR WANTS YOUR SUFFERING

Curses drop where blessings should. They stack. They make the run worse.

And the altar will trade them — the more you carried, the more it gives back. Greed is a mechanic here: hold the pain longer, cash it in bigger.

  • 20-30 minute runs, 5 stages, 3 difficulties
  • 30 colour forms, 9 apex awakenings, 96 pickups to find
  • 100% procedural pixel art and sound — every texture and every note is generated at runtime by our own code. No audio files ship at all; the only image files are the bitmap font atlases.
  • Hand-built rooms, dealt fresh every run
  • Rebindable keys and gamepad support
  • Unlocks, a conquest grid, and run records to chase

Play basketball your way. 

I mean, as long as your way involves playing on the moon, because that's our whole gig.

Play solo.

Push your basketball skills to the limit in low gravity physics. Slam insane dunks. Just like you do on earth, champ.

Challenge friends.

Play against your friends in 3v3 or HORSE. Want to feel superior to the machines? Play against computers instead.

Get creative.

How far can you throw? Okay, but how far can you actually make a basket? Watch the action up close with Ball Cam.

Add a little chaos.

Ready for a weird twist? Turn on asteroids and spaceships to really mix things up.

Moon Basketball.

Look, it's basketball on the moon. If that's not your thing, then we don't know what is.

Moon-Oriented Autonomous Biological Model

 Isn't it painful to think for too long? I can't think well because I can't sleep. This, this, this makes me suffer... Will this night protect us? There shouldn't have been things like smartphones... Fly me to the moon. Sometimes I feel an unbearable longing. Ah, what do I do now? Will we be okay? Will our Earth... our Earth... our Earth... Will the inevitable morning sun greet us? Love me... 4:05 is such a boring time. A dull and tedious time. Our time when we don't know where to go. Stories and songs we love will enrich our lives. We'll be okay.

-Feature

  • Short playtime of around 1 hour

  • Almost no combat or puzzle elements

  • A game where you progress the story by clicking elements on the screen

Your little ritual at the end of the day. Solve tonight’s Sudoku and earn a star in your sky. Keep coming back and your stars slowly draw constellations. A cat keeps you company from the observatory window while rain taps the glass and lo-fi plays on the radio. And when one puzzle isn’t enough, 5,000 more are waiting for you.

Every night, everyone gets the same Nightly Sudoku. Each constellation takes 7–12 nights to complete, there are four to choose from each month, and every star you earn stays yours.

Miss a night? Your constellation simply waits for you. A puzzle finished after midnight still counts for the night you started it, and a star earned under a full moon shines a little brighter.

5,000 more Sudoku puzzles come with the game:

  • 1,500 Easy
  • 1,500 Medium
  • 1,250 Hard
  • 750 Expert

No repeats until you’ve exhausted a difficulty. Every puzzle has one solution, reached through logic alone. No guessing required. Easy and Medium ease you in, Hard asks more of you, and Expert introduces techniques such as pointing pairs and subsets.

Notes work like pencil marks on paper: up to nine small numbers in a square, each in its own spot, and never checked. Every number is checked as you place it: correct answers lock in and clear their number from the notes in their row, column and box, while mistakes clear themselves. On the Nightly, each mistake adds 30 seconds to your time; on endless boards, the clock never affects your score. Your first mistake is explained, and each board gives you one to three hints, depending on difficulty. Take your time.

Between puzzles, it sits on the observatory’s window ledge. While you play, it wanders along the top of your Sudoku board, watching every move. Leave it alone long enough and it falls asleep right where it sits.

Click to pet it. Right-click, or click and hold, to change its coat: there are eight, from a plush gray Chartreux to a longhaired Ragdoll. Make a mistake and watch it wince. Get twelve correct answers in a row and it gives you a slow blink.

Some nights you’re solving Sudoku. Some nights you’re keeping the cat company.

Ten worlds wait beyond the observatory window. Watch cherry petals drift past the glass, settle in with rain falling outside, let fireflies glow in the dark, or look up for shooting stars. Change the view with the brass arrows beside the porthole, or tap the bracket keys while you play. Your Sudoku stays the same. The night changes around you.

MoonDoku FM has three stations: Chillhop, Bossa Nova and Downtempo. Add the sounds that suit the night (rain, a cozy café, a crackling fireplace, ocean waves or a distant storm), each at its own volume, so the room is as quiet or as atmospheric as you like. It all works offline.

When you want nothing but the puzzle, press F for Focus. The room fades away while your music keeps playing. Just you and the Sudoku.

  • 5,000 Sudoku puzzles are yours to keep. They live on your drive and work offline, with no account required. The Nightly is the one exception: it comes from the server, so it needs an internet connection.
  • Steam Cloud keeps your sky, your streak, your cat’s coat and your half-finished puzzle with you between machines.
  • Keyboard, mouse or controller. Type your numbers, click the 3×3 pad beside the board, or use a controller’s 3×3 picker.
  • 17 achievements to collect, from your first Easy solve to a thirty-night streak.
  • An optional free account. Want to see how your Nightly time compares? Sign in with an emailed code to see where you rank after each solve.
  • One purchase. No ads, no in-game store, nothing sold separately. No subscriptions, no energy system, no interruptions.
  • Windows, macOS and Linux.

Put the kettle on. Your cat is waiting by the window, and tonight’s puzzle is ready.

Falling through a dreamscape built from shattered memories, you follow an amnesiac boy across fractured fragments of consciousness — drawing closer, beat by beat, to a truth he's forgotten.

  • "Rhythm is your trajectory — whether 2K, 4K, 6K, or 8K."

  • "Every beat is a shot fired. Every combo charge the next explosion."

Morpheus Studio is an open-source chart editor that lets you import your favorite songs, and create your own charts!

Customize track width and height! Toggle visual effects on or off!

  • Track and note width, Track and camera angles

  • Core Shatter close-up effect toggle, Combo close-up effect toggle

  • Particle effect density, Camera shake intensity

  • Browse memory discs, choose your song, speed, and difficulty, and play tracks from 2K to 8K.

  • Hit memory crystals on beat, deplete enemy HP, shatter crystals, and recover memory fragments.

  • Build combos, unleash firepower, and dive into intense rhythm-driven battles.

  • Collect and store memory fragments after each run to unlock the boy’s lost memories.

  • Uncover the truth behind the dream!

  • Satisfying Hit Feedback: Every hit and combo delivers impactful visual feedback for a satisfying feel.

  • High-Speed Tunnel: A constantly advancing track creates a strong sense of speed in every song.

  • Combos That Grow Stronger: Build your combo to increase firepower. Break it, and everything resets.

  • Arcade-Style Judgement: Forgiving timing windows keep the action fun, even if you miss the beat slightly.

Morphsea: Abyssal Evolution is a single-player evolution game from a solo developer, built around freeform creature sculpting, survival, and deep-sea exploration. Explore, hunt, and evolve in a beautiful, procedurally generated underwater world.

Shape a Creature Like No Other

Freely shape your creature's body and equip it with parts that serve different functions. Eyes, mouths, fins, armor, spikes, and more don't just alter its appearance—they directly change its abilities and the way it survives.

There is no set path for evolution. Build for speed and agility, using keen senses to stay out of danger; or strengthen your offense and defense to become a predator that hunts other creatures. Shape a life form that is truly your own!

Hunt. Grow. Evolve.

Track down prey smaller than you, but beware of predators lurking just beyond your field of view. Feed to gain the nutrients you need to survive, then evolve into a larger, more formidable hunter and climb the food chain. But a larger body does not make you invincible. Your speed, attack strategy, resilience, and surroundings all shape the outcome of an encounter. Sometimes the best way to survive is not to fight, but to flee.

Explore the Ocean's Deepest Reaches

Explore a procedurally generated ocean, discovering the distinct landscapes and life found in each layer as you descend from the shallows into the abyss. As you go deeper, light fades, pressure mounts, and ecosystems transform around you. Creatures lurking in the abyss bring new threats, and a body built to dominate the shallows may be all but helpless in the depths.

To dive deeper, you must keep evolving.

Every piece is living on borrowed time.


Mortal Chess is a chess variant you can play against the AI or in local split-screen PvP, where your pieces have a visible life countdown.



Winning takes more than finding checkmate. You must manage a dwindling army, harvest coins, extend the lives of key pieces, and deploy reinforcements at exactly the right moment.

Both sides begin with a lean army: one king, rook, knight, bishop, and four centered pawns. There are no starting queens. If you want one, you will have to earn it.

HOW TO PLAY


Chess pieces move as normal. Checkmate wins as normal, but mortality creates another way to finish the fight!



If a king is left alone, that side loses unless it can afford a legal LAST CHANCE deployment. Closing that final shop without buying accepts defeat.

If only the two kings remain, the game is a draw.

Choose from Easy, Normal, Hard, or Brutal countdown pressure, then adjust the Black AI from Quick to Maximum thinking effort.

Made as part of GMTK JAM 2026 for the theme COUNTDOWN.

Mortal Realm Survivors combines the shop rerolls, star upgrades, and synergy-building of auto battlers with survivor-like action.

Resistance fighter Li Anbang and Luo, an intelligent entropy beast, must work together to break through the endless swarms. Follow their journey, experience the thrill of growing stronger and mowing down enemies, and uncover traces of the civilization left behind after the fall of the Mortal Realm.

SURVIVE THE ENTROPY BEAST SWARMS

Public portals in the Mortal Realm work much like bus stops on Earth: they only activate at regular intervals. Although the Mortal Realm has fallen, its automated arcane systems continue to operate as designed. Li Anbang must survive until the portal is ready. Keep moving, evade the incoming swarms, and hold out until activation!

PREPARE FOR THE NEXT BATTLE

"You humans actually considered this an acceptable level of security?"

— Luo

Luo possesses human-level intelligence and extensive knowledge of portal magic and machinery. With Luo's help, the teleportation process can be extended to create valuable opportunities to rest. Spend Psionic Shards to recover relics stranded within spatial rifts and put them to use in the battles ahead.

COLLECT RELICS AND MERGE THREE TO UPGRADE

Merge three copies of the same relic to create a higher-star version with far greater power. Spend your Psionic Shards wisely—or risk them all in pursuit of the perfect upgrade!

BUILD SYNERGIES AND SHAPE YOUR STRATEGY

"These are the psionic traces of those who came before us. I can feel a special power within them."

— Li Anbang

Relics from the same faction or with similar combat styles can form synergies. Equip more related relics to activate and strengthen those synergies, unlock higher-tier effects, and shape your build in different directions.

DEMO NOTES

This is a free demo currently under active development. Its content and overall quality will continue to improve.

- The demo includes Easy and Hard difficulty modes. The full game will offer a broader and smoother difficulty progression.

Game Mechanics:

Play multiple player remnants at the same time, in parallel.

Use W/A/S/D or left/right/up/down to queue all player remnants to move together.

Use Q/E to move the player remnants to Light Dimension and Dark Dimension respectively.

Use F to Flip all player remnants to the opposite dimension they're already in.

Set up a move sequence, then simulate.

Collect all the World Pieces to stitch the fragment.

You can interact with items like walls/spikes/collectibles of the same Dimension as a Player Remnant.

Die on interacting with Spikes on the same dimension as the player remnant.

If you're in the Dark Dimension, jump into the Light Dimension, If you're in the Light Dimension, jump into the Dark Dimension. Hit the world edge (wall), and the player stops walking.

You start a level by queuing up actions using the W/A/S/D/Q/E/F buttons, and then hit the Simulate button to simulate the sequence. If you have collected all the World Pieces in the level, you will have stitched the fragment in the timeline, and you move on to the next fragment. Else? Fragment Reset. So strategize well, before you start the simulation. You can stop the simulation manually as well, but you still lose those points ;)

Look out for portals, you can use them strategically to jump through, and your walk continues. You can only use portals that are in the same Dimension as the player.

Which portal connects to which portal? The shape of the portal identifies that.

Use switches in the same Dimension to unlock the locks for certain World Pieces, or Obstacles.

The gold you earn goes back into the forge and shop. Buy Brokk a heavier hammer or better bellows, and Brygida a new sign to bring in more customers. A whetstone improves your chances of forging rarer pieces, while counter decorations raise prices in the shop. You can speed up forging, increase earnings or save up for the next metal. Just leave some gold for ore.

As your equipment improves, the little workshop changes with it. You can also give the forge a different look by choosing a workshop style.

FROM COPPER TO MITHRIL

Start with copper, then unlock bronze and iron. Keep building up your forge to work with steel, silver, gold and finally mithril. Each new metal gives you another reason to get back to the anvil, fill your collection and invest in your workshop.

TRY THE FREE DEMO

The demo lets you forge with copper, bronze and iron. If you choose, you can carry over your collection, forge and shop upgrades, and gathered resources when the full game is released.

Add My Desktop Dwarf: Taskbar Forge to your wishlist and follow the game to keep up with the forge.

Privacy: The game counts key and mouse-button presses. It does not record the text you type. Gameplay works offline.

A short, relaxing and satisfying clean-up

Upgrade your net
Increase its strength, size, luck, double cast and more to catch all the objects in the lake.

Not every find is trash.
Wash hidden treasures and decorate your cozy house.

From grime to beauty.
Watch wildlife reclaim its place as you clean the lake.

Face the elements.
Tame a tornado with your net.

Fix your house.

Features
- Play at your own pace. Nothing in the game is going to rush you.
- Controller Support for Xbox and Playstation
- Steam Achievements
- More than 50 collectibles to wash and decorate
- Living and interactable wildlife
- Relaxing and satisfying gameplay

From an empty lot to a cyber arena

Start with $4,000 and an empty lot. Lay the floor, raise the walls, set up a reception desk and the first PCs — and watch the first gamers walk in. Every desk, sofa and coffee machine is placed by hand, and a crew of builders puts it all together.

Everything a computer club needs

  • Gaming PCs, console sofas and VR stations: connect the hardware, upgrade it level by level and charge more per session.

  • A bar, a kitchen and a restaurant with recipes from your patrons.

  • Servers and Wi-Fi to keep everyone online.

  • Paint the walls, pick floors from wood and tiles to arcade carpet, add decor for prestige and bigger tips.

  • A hand-drawn interface in the style of an admin's notebook.

A team to run it

Hire receptionists, technicians, bartenders, cooks, waiters, janitors and even hackers. Wages are due every day, PCs break down, deliveries arrive and the trash has to go out.

A living city

21 factions, from the police and the city hall to the local gang. Send gifts, fund them or hack them. Friends give perks; enemies send fines and raids.

Risky business

Short on cash? Build on credit. The bank charges interest every day and takes the club once the debt grows as big as the club itself.

And Luna

Luna is the club cat. She naps in her bed, eats from her bowl and loves to be petted. The game is made with love for Luna.

An incremental game that reimagines the classic Snake game.

The snake moves on its own

It tries its best to reach the apples by itself. Though it's not very bright...

Raising it is up to you

Moving is the snake's job — raising it is yours. Collect apple seeds to raise your snake. It can move faster. It can bite harder. You can even make it smarter.

Help it go the distance

Harsher places lie ahead. Prepare well, and give it the occasional small nudge.

My Summer Project Together is a cheerful summer adventure where a simple student project becomes an entire season of work, exploration, driving, and questionable decisions with friends. Play solo or team up with up to four players online as you build a car from scratch, earn money, roam the countryside, and chase the freedom of finally owning a car of your own.

Your project begins as a collection of parts. Buy components from local stores or search old vehicles, sheds, garages, cellars, and abandoned places for anything useful. Assemble the engine, fuel and electrical systems, suspension, wheels and tires, doors, hood, trunk, fenders, and everything else needed to turn a rusty pile into a working machine. Keep an eye on the practical details too: the car will still need engine oil and gasoline before the first proper road trip can begin.

Parts and supplies cost money, so take on jobs around town. Drive a taxi, help with harvesting, and spend your earnings on components, tools, food, drinks, and whatever else your summer requires. Every job brings your project a little closer to the road, while every trip through the countryside may uncover the one missing part you have been searching for.

Building the car is the goal, but it is still summer. Visit local shops and the pub, stock up on food, pizza, energy drinks, cigarettes, alcohol, and other products, explore the surrounding area, and enjoy the strange freedom of student life. Work at your own pace alone, or invite friends and turn the project into cooperative chaos as you search, earn, assemble, and inevitably get distracted together.

You finally have the chance to own your first car. There is only one small problem: you have to build it first. Find the parts, make some money, finish the car, and enjoy the summer.

Myriad Strategies is a turn-based grand strategy game centered on state governance, war command, and social crisis response.

Fully randomized world maps. Every run is a fresh experience!

Unique faction abilities and playstyles

Every nation comes with its own unique mechanics and abilities — from taming colossal beasts and building networks with distant nations, to researching military provisions and expanding the Great Wall, and much more.

The nation's ultimate goals are many and varied!

You can seize control of half the world's territory, produce enough food to feed the entire world, reduce the global refugee count to its absolute minimum, or spread an espionage network across the world and dominate it all! The situation shifts constantly—don't fixate on a single objective.

Over 1,500 characters, each with unique abilities

Every character has their own decree cards, tactic cards, and personal preferences and ambitions. Win them over, use them, and make them the cornerstone of your stable regime!

Lots of types of castles!

The entire map is a battlefield

A deep war-chess system where you weaken the enemy by breaking down the tiers of their troop formations.

Each cultural sphere has its own unique festivals and celebrations—put them to good use!

Characters follow many different paths, and even an unremarkable figure can reveal astonishing potential!

Painters and writers produce unique works, prospectors can discover new mines, educators can train other characters, wanderers drift unpredictably, martial artists roam the land honing their martial skills and perfecting their own dojos... Countless possibilities await your exploration.

careful with disasters!

The times are turbulent—take control of the world's refugee numbers!

Wars, plagues, famines, and other national crises all affect the global refugee count. Taking in refugees in moderation can strengthen your nation, but excessive intake can lead to unrest and a breakdown of public order.

When the world's refugee population exceeds a certain threshold, who knows what might happen to the world then...

Schemes and intrigue—stage a coup!

Infiltrate enemy strongholds with spies, carry out a variety of operations, and finally spring the trap to launch a coup.

Source, Discover, and Profit

Start your journey by accepting unique customer orders. You will need to source your inventory from returned shipments, garage auctions, and even walk-in clients! Every order comes with specific requirements and a target value. Your job is to hunt for the right items to fulfill the deal without going over budget and maximize your daily profits.

Uncover Hidden Value and Restore Treasures

Not everything is as it seems! Use specialized tools like UV lights, magnifying glasses, and scanners to identify rare traits or hidden autographs that can skyrocket an item's worth. Found a broken item? Don't throw it away! Take it to your workshop to clean, sand, and glue damaged goods back together, increasing their value and making them perfect for your next box.

Master the Art of "Reverse Unpacking"

Experience a satisfying packing mechanic where you must carefully organize items into boxes using a grid system. Space is limited, and every dollar counts. Go too cheap, and your customer rating will tank. Go too expensive, and you'll satisfy the buyer but eat into your own profit margins!

Grow Your Mystery Box Business

Reinvest your hard-earned cash to upgrade your house and workspace, unlock new garage areas, and purchase advanced identification tools. Gain access to higher-tier loot boxes and expand your item collection to take your mystery box business to the absolute next level.

Step into a universe where your most creative ideas come to life.

Myth-OS is an unprecedented AI-driven sandbox that shatters the boundaries of traditional gaming. Imagine having the infinite possibilities of a Tabletop RPG, guided by a dynamic digital Game Master, perfectly fused with the deep, complex simulation of a Grand Strategy epic.

Want to play a JRPG? You can! Want to play a pokemon style game? You can! Depending on how you set up your game, you can play a TTRPG, a Grand Strategy, a 4x, a paradox style crusader kings game, a Romance of the three kingdoms style strategy game, a Dungeons & Dragons campaign, a Pathfinder campaign, a Fallout campaign, a turn based strategy game, the possibilities are almost endless!

From Lone Adventurer to Emperor

Scale your adventure exactly to your playstyle. You can start your journey as a wandering vagabond with nothing but a sword and a dream, exploring ruins and taking on local bounties. But your story doesn't have to end there. Gather followers, build a settlement, and rise to power. Before long, you could be commanding armies, managing global supply chains, and ruling a vast empire.

Your Personal AI Game Master

Experience dynamic, emergent storytelling tailored specifically to your actions. The AI Game Master seamlessly weaves your choices into the world's narrative.

  • No Pre-Written Scripts: Quests, events, and NPC interactions are generated dynamically based on your current situation and past choices.

  • True Reactivity: If you burn down a village, the AI GM ensures the local lord sends an army after you, and nearby economies suffer from the loss of goods. No two campaigns will ever be the same.

  • Your Story, Your Style: Pick how it’s told, from plain and direct to dark and gritty, humorous, or light novel.

  • Fight Your Way: Let the story settle a fight, or take control yourself in manual combat.

A Deeply Simulated, Living World

While you are out adventuring, the world doesn't stand still. Myth-OS features a complex, underlying simulation that tracks thousands of entities in real-time.

  • Autonomous Factions: Rival empires engage in diplomacy, forge alliances, and declare war entirely on their own.

  • Living Economies: Market prices shift based on real supply and demand. Trade routes are established, and resources are physically tracked.

  • The Butterfly Effect: A bandit raid you ignored on Day 1 could lead to a kingdom collapsing on Day 100.

  • Lives of Their Own: Thousands of people work, travel, trade, grow stronger, grow old and have children, whether you’re there or not.

Let Time Pass: Skip an hour, a month or years. Houses keep deciding, armies march, convoys deliver, and it all goes into the world’s chronicle.

A World You Can Walk Through

  • Go from the whole realm to its countries, provinces, towns and buildings, down to the rooms inside, with rivers, roads, bridges and walls.

  • Towns grow with their people and are built in their own culture’s style. Zoom in to step inside.

Rewrite the Rules of Reality

Want to play in a completely different setting? You have the ultimate power to reshape the universe. Myth-OS is a genre-agnostic sandbox. You aren't locked into fantasy or sci-fi—you can build whatever you want. Write your own game rules, invent custom technology trees, and shift genres to create your perfect dream game.

Your words reshape the universe. What kind of world will you build?

Can you survive the horde? Choose your Mythia, unlock abilities, build overpowered loadouts, and escort Exposed Souls left by fallen enemies. Forge permanent Bonds and watch your creatures reach their Ascended Form! A solo monster-collector roguelite your Grimoire grows with every run.

Build a galactic empire and fight your battles alone or with a friend. A real-time space 4X with spectacular clashes in space and on the planets.

  • Build, expand and trade. Or cheat, steal and lie.
  • Plan your tactics in space battles and on planet surfaces alike.
  • Develop your ships, tanks and colonies your own way.
  • Answer distress calls, hire mercenaries, hunt for ancient relics.
  • Spy on your rivals and build diplomatic ties.
  • Galaxies of nearly 200 planets, with up to 12 empires.

Inspired by a legendary '90s Hungarian space strategy classic.

INDEPENDENT TRADERS ALLIANCE

NOTICE OF APPOINTMENT — CHECKPOINT OFFICER, THE NARROWS

Trade must flow. The Alliance is looking for a new checkpoint officer to see that it does.

THE POST

You will serve alone at the Narrows Checkpoint, controlling the ship traffic through the strait.

Each day, ships arrive seeking passage. Not all of them are cleared. Smart captains look for ways to fake an entry; some will try to smuggle contraband through the Narrows.

It is your job to sort them. Clear the approved. Stop the rest. Keep the lane moving at any cost.

Regional relations are, at present, in a period of adjustment. Officers should expect conditions to intensify over the course of their posting; hazard bonuses will be applied accordingly.

REQUIREMENTS

The Narrows is a high-volume posting. The Alliance seeks officers who meet the following criteria:

  • Registry proficiency: Must be able to operate the vessel registry and cross-reference documentation against records on file without assistance.

  • Acute vision: Strong unaided eyesight is essential. Much of what distinguishes a compliant vessel from an irregular one will not appear in its paperwork.

  • Sound judgement under pressure: Officers will make consequential decisions rapidly, repeatedly, and alone. Hesitation reduces throughput.

  • Composure in isolation: The post offers no relief, no partner, and no immediate support. Candidates must remain effective across extended solitary shifts.

  • Discretion: Officers will encounter sensitive traffic and sensitive offers. The Alliance expects its representatives to conduct themselves appropriately at all times.

  • Adaptability: Standing orders are subject to change without notice. The ability to comply with revised directives immediately is required.

*Excessive misconduct or suspicion of corruption may result in early termination of contract.
*Officers are prohibited from leaving their post until their contract is fulfilled.
*This notice was generated automatically by TradeGPT. The Alliance assumes no responsibility for its contents.

NEBULA BREAK is a family-friendly space shooter with a secret: the more you clear,

the more it transforms. Five stages plus hidden content, unlockable modes all the way

to TRUE BOSS RUSH — and a full-3D SPACE DIVE mode that breaks the rules of the genre.

🚀 ASSIST mode for younger players — more lives, more bombs, slower pace

👨‍👦 Two-player co-op — on the couch, or with a distant friend via Remote Play Together

💥 Coin-powered ship upgrades — from a single shot to 9-way fire plus homing missiles

🌌 Eleven galaxies — including ASSIST GALAXY, NORMAL GALAXY, SURFACE GALAXY where you land on the ground, the fully 3D SPACE DIVE, and even a secret galaxy

🌀 Vertical to side-scroll to full 3D. The deeper you go, the more the game changes

🎲 50+ minigames — trade medals for a completely different kind of play

⚡ One-button instant retry — "just one more run" never stops

🏆 Completion tracker and PERFECT CLEAR — a special reward for those who beat everything

🎵 100+ original tracks

🎮 Full gamepad support from title to results — supports Xbox and PlayStation (DualSense) controllers; other controllers can be configured in the in-game button settings (which you can also operate using the keyboard)

🌏 5 languages (EN, JA, Simplified & Traditional Chinese, Korean) / runs on low-spec PCs

Her story starts with the name you give her.

A cat-eared girl with no memory appears at your doorstep. You give her a name—and a place she can come home to.

NEKO MAKER 2: Starlit Girl is a single-player raising simulation with visual-novel storytelling. From age six to eighteen, share twelve years of learning, friendship, challenges, and farewells while uncovering her connection to the starlit cage.

Start each term by talking about her plans

Listen to her wishes, then choose a main pursuit, a term goal, and an optional activity. Drawing, performance, swordsmanship, magic, cooking, and study develop through sustained practice and tangible accomplishments.

Regular plans carry through the term, with room to adjust or pause. Basic learning and everyday events continue without extra classes, so you can also leave time for family, friends, and rest.

Make room for the moments that matter

Life continues after the plan is set. She may bring home new work, talk about a friend, or hesitate before an important opportunity. Choose a free-time activity each month, respond to her hopes and difficulties, and keep an eye on her mood, stress, and health.

Abilities, talents, time, and money all shape your options. Will you support the next challenge, or leave her room to find her direction at her own pace?

Let the holidays open new possibilities

Walk around the harbor, take a coastal journey, support her studies, practice a skill, or stay home with friends. Holiday time is limited: decide how to spend it, and bring shared experiences and memories into your next conversation about the term ahead.

See her progress—and hear what she wants

Build sketchbooks, performance records, training journals, and other records of her learning. Look back at each term and decide what to continue. Prepare for competitions, face opponents, and make tactical choices at key moments. As she grows and gains experience, her wishes change too.

Meet the harbor's people and follow the starlight

Get to know friends, teachers, and harbor residents. Explore different places and gather clues through diaries, memories, and puzzle fragments. Her past and the mystery of the starlit cage gradually become part of your everyday life together.

Where will twelve years lead her?

Your plans, responses, and relationships influence talent routes and multiple endings. Return for another playthrough to explore different choices and true endings.

She will grow up and find a direction of her own. The years you share will help her take the next step.

In the future, most people choose illusion over reality, escaping each night into artificially created fantasies called “neurodreams”. One day however, dreamers suddenly start losing their minds on a massive scale. Sam, a neurodream programmer, and Dave, a cybersecurity specialist, are drawn into an investigation that leads them deep into the human mind - to the place where our worst fears are born.

Features:

  • Cyberpunk and psychological horror atmosphere

  • Cinematic storytelling

  • Hundreds of unique illustrations

  • Mystery that keeps you guessing until the very end


Why you should add NEUROBROOD to your wishlist:

• To be among the first to dive into a dark cyberpunk horror

• To stay updated and not miss the demo and future updates

• To support the development of the project and become part of NEUROBROOD

Clock In With Your Crew

With your crew by your side, what's there to be afraid of?

Clean Every Corner

Scrub the floors, the walls and the ceilings. Rinse your mop often, or you'll only make the house dirtier.

Spend Your Pay on Gear

Use the money you earn from cleaning to buy gear from the truck's vending machine.

Better Gear, Less Work

Pressure washers, robot vacuums, a ride-on cleaning vehicle and tool carts will help you clean more efficiently.

Evict the Previous Tenants

A shotgun goes a long way toward reaching an amicable agreement with the tenants.

Fallen Coworker Rehiring Service

Get your fallen coworkers to the Boss's TV or the truck computer, fast. Leave a body lying around too long and the flies will find it.

Make It Back to the Truck in Time

Employees left behind will be rehired, for a fee.

After Work, Off to the Cinema

Rewatch every highlight of the job with your crew. The footage will be used for employee training.

After a hundred years of sleep, their father's castle is a ruin.

The late Demon King's children stand before an empty throne.

The brother's fists. A plush bear in his sister's arms.

Calling themselves the Dawn, they set out with no land and no followers.

NO KING IN HELL is a turn-based strategy RPG that connects an adventure among monsters with raising allies and leading them in a struggle for territory.

■ WALK A DEMON WORLD WITHOUT A KING

Market stalls in Ashen Castletown. Lamplit homes. A mine descending underground.

Monsters have lives, troubles, and reasons to lend you their strength.

Hear them out, fulfil a request, or earn their respect in a brawl.

Build a party through these encounters and reclaim the stolen town.

■ THE PLACE YOU EXPLORE BECOMES THE BATTLEFIELD

Towns, caves, and manors share the same terrain in exploration and combat.

Take the high ground, find a clear shot, and shield the sister with your front line.

Combine the brother's fists, the sister's magic and healing, and your companions' strengths.

Check hit chances and estimated damage before choosing your next move.

■ MAKE A STRONG ENEMY YOUR NEXT ALLY

Successfully Seize a weakened enemy and it joins your side during that battle, ready for your command.

Defeat it or bring it home: its strength is also its potential as an ally.

Give recruits classes and carry skills over from their previous jobs.

Evolve them when the conditions are right, or fuse two monsters into one.

■ FROM A SMALL PARTY TO A REALM

Reclaim the town to begin developing territory and commanding squads.

Promote a raised monster to a demon general and build a squad under its command.

Decide where to invade, where to defend, and how to expand the place you call home.

Seas at dawn. Volcanic mountain ranges. Rivers of the dead. Islands above the clouds.

An HD-2D continent built from three-dimensional terrain and pixel art connects your adventure to your campaign.

■ CHOOSE A LORD IN FREE MODE

Alongside the siblings' story, Free Mode lets you choose a ruler from eight factions.

Rival powers act independently, seize territory, and challenge your borders.

Collect monsters, raise squads, and pursue your own campaign across the continent.

Single-player. No stamina system or real-time waiting.

Playable offline.

* This game is currently in development. Systems, values, and screenshots are subject to change.
